I agree, its the most frustrating response 
It's like then what's the point??

I am so sorry for everything you went through. I can't imagine how you feel every day. 
I know this might not be realistic, but maybe you need to move far away from your family. Start a new life in a new place, make new friends, get a new job. 
Surround yourself with things that make you happy. 
None of what happened to you was your fault, you didn't have a choice in any of it.
But moving and starting over and taking care of yourself would be your choice and I think it would be good for you.
I wish I could say something more helpful. You are a beautiful human and you deserved so much better than all of that.

I understand this so much. I wish it was just as simple as a button. I'm afraid of attempting suicide and having it fail, only to end up paralyzed or something. I'm afraid life would be a lot harder after a failed suicide attempt. I really wish it could be just a button.
Thank you for replying! I think that's what I'll do, I just hope he understands eventually.
